_comment: Components the scanner cannot read from a package manager: container images, models, datasets, build tools and declared exceptions. Each entry was checked by hand on the date in 'checked'; re-check when the version changes.

components.name: postgis/postgis
components.note: PostgreSQL is under the PostgreSQL licence; PostGIS is GPL-2.0-or-later and runs unmodified as part of the database server. Our code talks to it over the network only.

components.name: binwiederhier/ntfy
components.note: Dual-licensed Apache-2.0 / GPL-2.0; we use it under Apache-2.0.

components.name: python
components.use: Base image for the API and the AI worker
components.note: Debian base packages (some GPL, e.g. bash, coreutils) are separate OS programs, not linked into our code.

components.name: node
components.use: Base image for the WhatsApp gateway
components.note: Debian base packages as for the python image.

components.name: chromium (Debian bookworm)
components.use: Headless browser run by whatsapp-web.js, separate process
components.note: Chromium bundles third-party code under permissive and LGPL licences; it runs as a separate, unmodified program.

components.name: nvcr.io/nvidia/tensorrt
components.use: Base image for the GPU AI worker (Dockerfile.gpu), built on the client's server
components.note: NVIDIA Deep Learning Container licence. Declared exception (Section 19): pull from NVIDIA on the server; never push the built image to a public registry or ship it to clients. Re-check NVIDIA's terms before any hosted release.

components.name: YOLOX-S and YOLOX-Nano ONNX weights
components.note: Weights released by Megvii under Apache-2.0 in the YOLOX repository; downloaded with a SHA-256 check by tools/fetch-models.sh, not stored in git.

components.name: COCO 2017 (training data of the YOLOX weights)
components.use: Not shipped or used by us; listed because the model weights were trained on it
components.note: Annotations are CC BY 4.0; images are under their Flickr licences. We do not redistribute the dataset. Our own fine-tuning, if any, must use only datasets that allow commercial use.

components.name: OpenCV sample video vtest.avi
components.use: Demo and tests only (fetch-models.sh --demo), never shipped

components.name: NSIS
components.use: Builds the Windows Wall Agent installer
components.note: The installer stub is under the zlib/libpng licence; the bzip2 part is under a BSD-style licence.

components.name: Go toolchain and standard library
components.use: Builds the Wall Agent; the standard library is compiled into it

components.name: Hikvision NVRs, cameras and firmware
components.use: Client-owned devices, reached only through ISAPI and RTSP

components.name: WhatsApp network
components.use: External messaging network used through a linked phone
components.note: Unofficial client (whatsapp-web.js). WhatsApp may restrict the number; e-mail and push are the fallbacks.

components.name: NVIDIA driver and CUDA
components.use: GPU driver on the AI server, installed from NVIDIA
